manifest_title: AETHON Scientific Calibration & Data Validation Manifest
project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map
study_site: Gediz Vallis Boxwork Ridges, Lower Mount Sharp, Gale Crater (-4.787°S, 137.393°E)

photogrammetric_uncertainty_model.stereo_dtm_source: MRO HiRISE Stereo Pair PSP_009149_1750 / PSP_009294_1750 (USGS / NASA PDS)
photogrammetric_uncertainty_model.scientific_basis: Empirical stereo photogrammetric precision review for Mars HiRISE DTMs (Kirk et al. 2008; Tao et al. 2022). Relative vertical precision is on the order of tens of centimeters; 0.25m corresponds to ~0.25 GSD precision threshold.
photogrammetric_uncertainty_model.figure_of_merit_filtering: FOM correlation quality values <= 0 and fill/extrapolated margins masked to NODATA (-9999.0).

solar_illumination_calibration.algorithm: NASA GISS Mars24 Ephemeris (Allison & McEwen 2000; Allison 1997)
solar_illumination_calibration.decoupling_rule: Optical solar shade blocks direct photons for illumination and thermal context; it does NOT provide omnidirectional GCR radiation shielding.

radiation_shielding_calibration.baseline_data: NASA PDS MSL-M-RAD-3-RDR-V1.0 (0.64 +- 0.12 mSv/day dose equivalent, 210 uGy/day absorbed dose)

separate_research_prototype.terrain_assumptions: 1.0116m HiRISE DTM with 360° horizon ray-march (72 azimuth sectors)
separate_research_prototype.atmosphere_assumptions: CO2 gas at ~815 Pa with vertical column depth X_0 = 20 g/cm^2 and slant depth X(alpha) = X_0 / sin(alpha)
separate_research_prototype.surface_material_assumptions: Regolith bulk density rho = 1.65 g/cm^3, consolidated rock density rho = 2.65 g/cm^3
separate_research_prototype.particle_spectrum_assumptions: GCR primary proton/helium spectrum modulated by solar cycle (Badhwar-O'Neill 2020 / Matthiä et al. 2016)
separate_research_prototype.calibration_assumptions: Zenith-peaked downward flux dD/dOmega ~ sin^2.55(alpha) (Khaksari et al. 2022) with secondary albedo neutron offset factor eta = 0.80
separate_research_prototype.rad_validation: Validated against MSL Curiosity RAD Murray Buttes Butte M12 (Sols 1456–1467, Ehresmann et al. 2021): 19% sky obstruction produced 4.0% +- 1.2% dose reduction; model predicts 4.1% (<0.3% error).

cross_site_electrostatics.detection_citation: Chide, B., Maurice, S., Murdoch, N. et al. (2025) Nature 638, 291–296
cross_site_electrostatics.observation: 55 candidate triboelectric micro-discharges detected by SuperCam microphone at Jezero Crater
cross_site_electrostatics.gale_crater_status: Discharges observed at Jezero; no validated local Gale risk estimate in this release.
cross_site_electrostatics.no_continuous_map_policy: Continuous hazard maps excluded; sample observed events tabulated with Sol, LST, location, and PDS provenance.

deliquescence_compatibility.calibration_basis: REMS relative humidity sensor recalibration (Harri et al. 2014; Rivera-Valentín et al. 2018/2020)
deliquescence_compatibility.humidity_convention: Relative humidity with respect to liquid water (RH_liq) for perchlorate deliquescence phase diagram
deliquescence_compatibility.salt_assumptions: Calcium perchlorate Ca(ClO4)2·4H2O eutectic system (T_e = 198.15 K, RH_e = 52.0%)
deliquescence_compatibility.uncertainty: RH uncertainty +-2% to +-5% daytime, +-10% to +-15% nocturnal; temperature +-1.5 K
deliquescence_compatibility.geotechnical_limit: Thermodynamic compatibility does NOT establish regolith shear strength; no slurry penalty without geotechnical sensors.

spacesuit_thermal_policy.sublimator_pressure_formula: NOT IMPLEMENTED without sourced Mars-suit model and validated parameters
spacesuit_thermal_policy.rationale: Vacuum sublimator physics fails at ~815 Pa ambient; SWME and SEAR are researched alternatives.

tier_1_automated_test_suites.test_aethon_marswalk: 17 unit tests (DTM bounds, slope gradient, science layers, UI compliance)
tier_1_automated_test_suites.test_routing_engine: 5 unit tests (A* exact termination, admissible heuristic, nodata barrier)
tier_1_automated_test_suites.test_viewshed_los: 8 unit tests (4-state visibility, planetary curvature, grazing ray uncertainty)
tier_1_automated_test_suites.test_solar_shadow: 7 unit tests (Mars24 solar position, cliff shadow, GCR decoupling)
tier_1_automated_test_suites.test_radiation_shelter: 6 unit tests (360° sky mask, Murray Buttes M12 validation, albedo physics)

tier_2_scientific_provenance_audit.reproducibility: All raster statistics and candidate routes recomputed directly from checked-in GeoTIFF and elevation grid JSON.
